Before requesting a quote

What information do I need?

Share the location, cabin count and intended opening month. A site plan and utility details help us prepare a precise estimate.

Is a fitted bathroom included?

The plan includes an enclosed room. Fixtures, waterproofing and ventilation are quoted for each project.

How can I estimate payback?

Use the actual room rate and occupied nights. Deduct commissions, cleaning, maintenance and tax, then compare against total installation and fit-out costs.
